Method of Attack: Distributed via malspam with attached malicious document containing macros that download and install ransomware
Connects to Command & Control server to register victim and receive ransom note
Locally generates encryption key sent to C2 server
Encrypts all files except those in Windows folder by appending .encrypt extension
Creates ransom note READ_ME_NOW.txt in each folder
Communicates with C2 server during encryption with PING messages
Sends final message with encryption summary to C2
Attack Vector: Malspam with malicious document containing macros
